name: Job Hunting
source:
Emma is a young adult that just got out of college, as many others. She´s just started job hunting and went to a lot of job interviews without any success. Help her in her twenty something attempt.

[From [url=https://vllm24.itch.io/job-hunting]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
和许多同龄人一样，艾玛是一名刚从大学毕业的年轻人。她最近刚开始找工作，参加了好几场面试却全都空手而归。快来帮她应对这第二十几次求职尝试吧。
